connectivity.title: Connectivity & high-availability infrastructure
connectivity.summary: Starlink links, UniFi networks, FortiGate NGFW firewalls and Yeastar telephony: an architecture designed to reduce downtime and simplify recovery.

features.title: Starlink links
features.description: High-speed satellite terminals with automatic failover where site configuration allows, for isolated sites or mobile fleets.

features.title: Centrally managed UniFi networks
features.description: Enterprise Wi-Fi and switches with captive portal, VLANs and unified supervision.

features.title: FortiGate NGFW firewalls
features.description: Next-generation network security integrated into the connectivity layer.

features.title: Yeastar telephony
features.description: Unified professional IP telephony: calls, conferences and integration with business tools.

features.title: Redundant links
features.description: Fibre, satellite and 4G/5G combined per site, with a documented and tested failover procedure.

connectivity.benefit: Stronger business continuity: redundant links, supervision and documented failover procedures.

security.title: Cybersecurity & video surveillance
security.summary: Protection for your digital and physical assets: network security, IP video surveillance (Hikvision, Dahua) and supervised penetration tests.

features.title: FortiGate NGFW firewalls
features.description: IPS, application filtering and VPN to protect your perimeter.

features.title: Hikvision / Dahua IP video surveillance
features.description: High-definition cameras with assisted detection, night vision and secure remote access.

features.title: Supervised penetration tests
features.description: Ethical tests carried out within a contractual scope to identify and fix vulnerabilities.

features.title: Hardening
features.description: Systematic hardening of equipment and removal of default access.

features.title: VLAN segmentation & recovery plan
features.description: Separation of video and business networks, with a documented business recovery plan.

security.benefit: Better-protected assets and premises, with private video streams and a segmented network.

iot-tracking.title: IoT, tracking & MDM
iot-tracking.summary: Fleet geolocation, mobile device management (MDM) and IoT sensors: real-time visibility over your operations.

features.title: Fleet geolocation
features.description: GPS vehicle tracking, history, geofence alerts and usage reports.

features.title: Device management (MDM)
features.description: Remote configuration, security and supervision of professional smartphones and tablets.

features.title: IoT sensors
features.description: Telemetry, temperature and energy: connect and manage your physical equipment.

features.title: Alerts & reports
features.description: Configurable notifications and usage reports to support your decisions.

features.title: Integration & API
features.description: Connection with your existing business software for a single, reliable source of data.

iot-tracking.benefit: Real-time visibility over your fleets and devices, with configurable alerts.

ai-automation.title: AI innovation & autonomous systems
ai-automation.summary: Local deployment of open-source AI agents (Hermes Agent, OpenCode AI) on Linux to automate your operations while keeping control of your data.

features.title: Open-source AI agents
features.description: Local deployment of Hermes Agent and OpenCode AI to run complex tasks autonomously.

features.title: Fine-tuning & custom models
features.description: Adaptation of language models to your company's specific needs.

features.title: Operations automation
features.description: Self-managed scripts, pipelines and workflows, without systematic cloud dependency.

features.title: Linux environment
features.description: Controlled Linux infrastructure: security, control and documented costs.

features.title: Supervision & maintenance
features.description: Agent monitoring, model versioning and regular activity reports.

ai-automation.benefit: Local automation of your processes, with data hosted according to your choice.
